rule: A family shares timing and rig conventions, never blind mesh transforms. Every weapon keeps its own grip, trigger, support-hand, magazine and sight sockets.

ak_pattern.mechanism: curved detachable magazine and right-side charging handle

ar_pattern.mechanism: detachable rifle magazine; bullpups require weapon-specific magazine and support-hand sockets

p90_top_mag.mechanism: top-mounted horizontal magazine; never inherits box-mag hand paths

battle_rifle.mechanism: full-size detachable magazine and long receiver

revolver.mechanism: swing-out cylinder; never inherits pistol magazine motion

bolt_sniper.mechanism: manual bolt cycle; magazine treatment remains weapon-specific

semi_auto_scoped.mechanism: scoped semi-automatic rifle; each magazine/receiver gets its own sockets

lmg.mechanism: belt or box-fed heavy weapon; dedicated reload

knife.mechanism: melee; dominant grip and safe support-hand silhouette
